name: mcp__remotion__list_assets
description: List only current task input filenames and versions. Use media probing for actual stream properties.

name: mcp__remotion__pin_asset
description: Select and pin one current task asset by exact filename; returns a versioned source handle.

name: mcp__remotion__probe_media
description: Read actual media properties of a previously selected source_id. No source selection or editing choice.

name: mcp__remotion__probe_asset
description: Direct ordinary-tool baseline: select a filename and read its actual properties in one call.

name: mcp__remotion__read_source
description: Read the current single-file composition and its exact entry-file SHA256.

name: mcp__remotion__inspect_render
description: Return native-size pixels for each requested video frame, with exact frame indices and times.

name: mcp__remotion__write_source
description: Write src/index.tsx only. Return its SHA256 for the explicit render guard; this is a write operation.

name: mcp__remotion__render_composition
description: Render current source, fully decode it, and publish this task's MP4 and editable source.

name: mcp__remotion__write_notes
description: Save bounded edit notes in this task's out/edit-notes.md; never modify user originals.

name: mcp__remotion__render_source
description: Write model-authored TSX and actually render it, using the same ordinary renderer.

name: mcp__remotion__run_command
description:
Run foreground media analysis in this Session's fixed renderer container.

        /work is the current Remotion project; ffmpeg, ffprobe, Node and the
        installed Remotion runtime are available. No network, credentials,
        foreign Sessions or writable user originals. Use this for actual audio
        samples/volume measurements, not native Bash dependency downloads.
